newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Regent to launch $50 mln Ukraine invest fund.
newsitem.headline: Regent to launch $50 mln Ukraine invest fund.

text.p: Regent Pacific Group, the Hong Kong- and London-based fund management group, plans to launch a $50 million Ukraine investment fund starting next week, its Kiev representative said on Tuesday.
"The fund is imminent," Andrew Leasor told Reuters by phone from London. "We have raised just under 40 percent of the $50 million."
"We will get the $50 million," he added.
Regent will invest the three-year fund in equities, debt, and privatisation certificates.
"For this particular fund the intention is to give access to the Ukrainian market, which is an emerging market, to those who don't have the time or experience to invest directly," Leasor said.
Regent has focussed on Russian, other Eastern European, and Asian markets.
Colin Kingsnorth, a Regent manager, said there were about 400 Ukrainian companies being privatised monthly, and that Ukraine's Treasury bill market was also attractive.
"It's a tremendous, exciting market developing at a tremendous pace," Kingsnorth said. --Irene Marushko, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
